t: What Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors Is
title: What Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Commercial nuclear fusion reactors are power plants that generate electricity by fusing light atomic nuclei — the process that powers the sun — producing immense energy from seawater-derived fuel with no long-lived radioactive waste and no meltdown risk. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors in one line: Commercial nuclear fusion reactors are power plants that generate electricity by fusing light atomic nuclei — the process that powers the sun — producing immense energy from seawater-derived fuel with no long-lived radioactive waste and no meltdown risk.
Why it matters: Fusion offers effectively limitless, clean, always-on energy from abundant fuel..
Where it is used: baseload grid power, industrial heat, desalination, hydrogen production..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors
title: Current Research State of Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: NIF achieved ignition (net energy gain) in 2022; ITER assembles the world's largest tokamak; private companies (Commonwealth Fusion, Helion, TAE) race with compact designs and high-temperature superconducting magnets. Research targets net electricity, tritium breeding, and materials surviving neutron bombardment. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Commercial Nuclear Fusion Reactors currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
key_points: State of play: NIF achieved ignition (net energy gain) in 2022; ITER assembles the world's largest tokamak; private companies (Commonwealth Fusion, Helion, TAE) race with compact designs and high-temperature superconducting magnets.
Leading approaches: tokamaks, stellarators, inertial confinement, magneto-inertial (Z-pinch, FRC).
Key institutions and programs: ITER, NIF, Commonwealth Fusion Systems, Helion, TAE Technologies, General Fusion.
What would change the timeline: the challenges record lists the blockers.
